levels.surface: الْحاكِم أَبُو عَلِي الحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أحْمَدالْبِيْهَقِيُّ

notes: «الحاكم» is part of the name as written; the text joins «أحمد» and «البيهقي» with no space, kept as written
«بِنِيْسابُورَ سِنَةَ...» is a place and a date: not links
Abu Abbad speaks the report («قال: كَانَ جُلُوسُ الرِّضَا»), so he is the last link; al-Rida is described, not a link (rule 6)
